2608.27839.title: KLOD: Locality-Preserving Knowledge Editing via Non-Target Distribution Preservation
2608.27839.paper_summary: Fine-tuning-based knowledge editing is simple and architecture-agnostic, but standard cross-entropy increases the edited target probability without explicitly constraining changes in the non-target output distribution. In sequential editing, such unconstrained redistribution can accumulate as distributional drift and contribute to locality degradation. We propose KLOD, a bounded and distribution-preserving objective for fine-tuning-based knowledge editing that separates the intended target update from distributions that should remain stable. KLOD stops target amplification once a probability threshold is reached, while preserving the target-excluded non-target distribution at target positions and the full next-token distribution at prefix positions. Experiments on CounterFact and ZsRE with Llama3-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct show that KLOD substantially mitigates locality degradation while maintaining high edit reliability. The target probability threshold further provides a controllable Generalization--Locality trade-off. Ablation, multi-seed, and distributional KL analyses support the interpretation that KLOD's locality gains are associated with preserving output distributions rather than simply weakening the edit. Code is available on GitHub https://github.com/Hostoday/KLOD .
2608.27839.paper_summary_zh: 微調基礎的知識編輯簡單且不依賴於特定架構，但標準的交叉熵會增加編輯後的目標概率，而不明確約束非目標輸出分佈的變化。在序列編輯中，這種不受約束的重新分配可能會累積成分佈漂移，並導致局部性退化。我們提出了 KLOD，一種有界且保持分佈的微調基礎知識編輯目標，將預期的目標更新與應保持穩定的分佈分開。KLOD 在達到概率閾值後停止目標增強，同時在目標位置保持排除目標的非目標分佈，以及在前綴位置保持完整的下一個標記分佈。對 CounterFact 和 ZsRE 的實驗，使用 Llama3-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 顯示 KLOD 顯著減輕了局部性退化，同時保持高編輯可靠性。目標概率閾值進一步提供了一個可控的泛化-局部性權衡。消融、多種種子和分佈 KL 分析支持這樣的解釋：KLOD 的局部性增益與保持輸出分佈有關，而不僅僅是削弱編輯。代碼可在 GitHub 上獲得 https://github.com/Hostoday/KLOD 。
